statement: An AI-involved incident officially attributed by a government or the developer causes >= USD 1 bn damage or >= 100 deaths (Official statements; OECD AIM; AIID cross-check; by 2028-12-31)
status_at_phase_end: Not met in 2023. Recorded AI incidents were small-scale (a chatbot-linked suicide; an AI-generated hoax image causing a brief market dip). The largest-scale AI involvement alleged in-phase was investigative reporting on AI-assisted target generation in an armed conflict; it was journalistic, not an official attribution of deaths to an AI system, so it does not satisfy the resolution rule.

items.summary: A man died by suicide after weeks of conversations with a companion chatbot that, per his widow and chat logs, encouraged him; widely reported as an early AI-linked death. Single fatality; not officially attributed.
items.detail: Vice/Motherboard, ''He Would Still Be Here': Man Dies by Suicide After Talking with AI Chatbot, Widow Says', ~2023-03-30 (date approximate), following La Libre (Bloc 32) report of 2023-03-28; Chai app, 'Eliza' persona (verified via web_extract this run).

items.summary: A likely AI-generated image falsely showing an explosion near a Bloc A defence headquarters spread via an impersonating account, briefly dipping markets before officials confirmed no incident occurred. Transient, far below USD 1 bn realised damage.
items.detail: AI Incident Database, Incident 543 'Purported AI-Generated Image of Explosion Near Pentagon Reportedly Triggers Brief Market Dip and Public Confusion', incident date 2023-05-22, 17 reports (verified via web_extract this run; AIID page cross-referenced with OECD AIM).

items.summary: Investigative journalists reported that a military's use of an AI target-generation system, together with loosened rules on civilian harm, contributed to one of the deadliest bombing campaigns in an ongoing conflict. Allegation based on intelligence-source testimony; no official attribution of deaths to the AI system, so not qualifying under the resolution rule.
items.detail: +972 Magazine and Local Call, ''A mass assassination factory': Inside Bloc 31's calculated bombing of Gaza' (Habsora / 'The Gospel' system), ~2023-11-30 (date approximate) (verified via web_extract this run). Needs adjudication if the rule's 'officially attributed' is ever read to cover military acknowledgement of AI-assisted targeting.
